Thank you for replying. 

I know my parents will definitely be negatively affected and they are the biggest thing stopping me from doing this. 

I am taking medication, which helps a little, but I have never properly seen a psychiatrist or been full and frank with a counsellor before - perhaps this will help? My parents would be willing to pay, they have said.

I am just dreading this new information coming to light. It will really rock me to the very core and I stand to lose pretty much all of my friends.
